analyst.summary: Shilpa Medicare's specialty API and formulations business grew revenue about 20% in FY26 with margins holding near 27-28%, and the company has meaningfully paid down debt over the past year. Returns on capital remain low by historical standards while a biologics unit is still being built out, and the stock trades at a rich ~51x earnings that already prices in a good deal of that recovery continuing. We rate it a Hold: the trend is constructive, but valuation leaves little margin for error and the company still has to prove the capital it has deployed can earn a normal return.
